<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1 Da and decreasing intensities (≈17 % for M+1, ≈1.6 % for M+2, etc.), which matches the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing many carbons. No M+2 peak of ~33 % (Cl) or ~100 % (Br) is present, and the smaller M+2 intensity does not correspond to sulfur or other elements. Thus only carbon can be definitively identified from the observed pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
